name: Pasta Romanov
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Pasta (taglietelli, spaghetti, or angel hair preferred)
Mascarpone cheese (or similar mild cheese like ricotta)

steps: Boil a pot of salted water, add the pasta, and cook until al dente. Drain.
Melt the cheese (do not overheat) and stir in a little tomato puree to turn it salmon pink.
Add a slug (a couple tbsp) of vodka to the melted cheese.
Add caviar to the cheese and toss the drained pasta in it to coat.
Cut lemon into wedges and use as garnish with a tsp or two of caviar.
Serve with champagne or crisp white wine.
